beige.text: Uncertainty was causing businesses to defer capital spending and put projects on hold.
Demand for large capital equipment slowed overall, though packaging machinery remained strong; utilities were investing in infrastructure capacity.
Capital-equipment order pipelines improved; renewed interest in robotics/automation; businesses still dealing with considerable uncertainty.
Demand for capital equipment stable or increasing; customers making cost-saving investments and executing previously delayed purchases.
Manufacturing activity rising modestly; continued investment in productivity-enhancing AI technologies.
